interrupted.description: Set on an assistant message whose generation was cut short by an interrupt — the text is a mid-sentence fragment, not a reply. Carried into the next turn's context so the model can see it said only this much before being talked over, and decide for itself whether to resume, restate or move on. Storage that drops unknown fields loses the marker but keeps the fragment, which degrades to a truncated reply.

undelivered.description: Set on a tool message whose result arrived after the run was interrupted, so the model never got to describe it. The work happened; only the reply about it was lost. It is ordinary thread context on the next turn — the model raises it unprompted ("that deploy did go through") rather than the result being silently dropped or replayed as a fresh tool call.

error.description: Set when the tool threw rather than returned. Carried separately from `result`, which is a rendered string by the time it is persisted — a tool may legitimately return text beginning `Error:`, so the prefix cannot be read as a failure signal.
